cp1_holes.edge: Holes: windows/gaps stay inside the mask — do NOT cut them out.

cp2_slice.edge: Slice: adjacent same-class vehicles must be separate instances.

cp5_occlusion.edge: Occlusion: an object split by another is still ONE mask; count instances right.

cp3_thin.edge: Thin structures: poles/signs need a 2-3px brush.

cp4_curb.edge: Curb: road vs sidewalk is a functional boundary, same asphalt.

cp6_coverage.edge: Coverage: label every pixel — no unlabeled gaps (check coverage %).
